title: Milestone 2: run the harness on your own data
description: Extend the bias-decisions harness so a user can point it at their own dataset instead of the bundled Bias in Bios sample. Document the input format and add a walkthrough for running an end-to-end evaluation on custom data.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Shape is fixed: tasks/<slug>/items.jsonl plus question.yaml with ordered options; the CLI does not yet ingest an arbitrary corpus.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Milestone 2 runs the harness on custom data

Scenario: A user can point bd at their own dataset instead of the bundled sample
  Given a user's own dataset in the documented input format instead of the bundled Bias in Bios sample
  When they follow the walkthrough and run bd score end to end
  Then the harness produces a studies/ record for their data in the same replayable format as the bundled sample

right_now_summary: The input format is set, but custom dataset support and the end-to-end walkthrough still need work.
